headline: A new character sheet, talents, status effects, and a hit/evade model you can open up.
notes: New Aether Codex character sheet, now the SL2 Calculator experience.
Added talents: 40 talents and 135 subtalents, ranked by subpoint spend, with their stat and Hit modifiers folded into the build.
Adaptation subtalents now grant weapon access by Rarity, so a class can legally equip a weapon its own list does not offer.
Added a status effect catalogue: 53 statuses, including which subraces cannot be inflicted with each one.
Added a hit and evade model. Every figure opens to show where it came from, including flanking, the shared +50 bonus ceiling, and the 5%/75% floor and cap while Blind.
Derived values now name their sources. A capped Hit or Evade figure says which effects are competing for the ceiling and how much is being discarded.
Added an opponent gauntlet: 7 community reference statlines a build can be scored against, with counter-build mode to target specific ones.
Hands, legs and accessory slots now take upgrade points at +1 of their stat per point, plus Fortune and Greed on accessories.
Builds now record which world they are played in. G6 raises every upgrade ceiling by one; Korvara uses the base caps.
Added a mobile layout with swipe between tabs and touch-sized controls.
Armor is now spelled the way the game spells it everywhere in the interface; some labels and messages previously read "armour".
Optimizer has been removed for now for extensive reworks.
